mgcp.description: MGCP-specific configuration for media gateway operation

bind_address.description: IP address to bind the MGCP control interface to (e.g., management or signaling network)

port.description: UDP port for MGCP messages (RFC 3435 default is 2427)

reboot_timeout.description: Time in seconds before the gateway reboots if no activity from MGCP controller

rtp_bridge.description: Enable RTP media bridging between endpoints

endpoint_address.description: IP address used in MGCP responses for endpoint identification

rtp_port_range.description: Local RTP port range for media streams

start.description: Lowest local UDP port for RTP

end.description: Highest local UDP port for RTP

endpoints.description: List of static MGCP endpoints (e.g., for each BTS or BSC connection)

rtp_bind.description: Bind RTP port locally (true) or use remote SDP address

mode.description: RTP direction: rx (receive-only), tx (transmit-only), or rx/tx (bidirectional)

codec.description: Codec to use (e.g., g711-64k, g729, amr)

tone.description: Enable tone generation (e.g., for DTMF or busy tones)

sdp_origin.description: Override SDP origin line (e.g., '0 0 IN IP4 10.0.0.1'). Leave blank to use default.

crcx_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for Create Connection (CRCX) responses

tlcx_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for Modify Connection (MDCX) responses

tfcx_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for Modify Connection (MDCX) for connection removal

transcoding.description: Enable media transcoding (requires osmo-mgw with transcoding support and codecs)

legacy_sdp.description: Use legacy SDP format (RFC 2327 style) instead of RFC 3264

loopback_address.description: Optional IP for loopback testing interface (e.g., 127.0.0.2)
